text:
marta: Hey all — I addressed the requested changes on PR #4721 (split helper, added guard for empty prefixes, added unit tests). PTAL when you have a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4721

ci-bot: CI started for branch marta/kv-fallback (linux, macos, integration) :gear:

kevin: Quick skim — change looks solid. one tiny nit: rename helper from `prefix_helper` to `merge_prefix_cache` to make intent clearer? otherwise lgtm :+1:

marta: good call, renamed and pushed (force). also added a focused test: `test_eviction_on_sequence_boundary` to cover the bug we saw in staging logs.

emily: CI hit a macOS flake earlier on this PR, might need a rebase against main to avoid the known test ordering issue. can you rebase and push, @marta?

marta: rebased onto main and force-pushed. macOS job rerun queued. thanks for the heads-up.

ci-bot: macOS job passed. All checks green. Mergeable label added.

kevin: ok from me — LGTM. planning to merge after tomorrow morning canary window (keep the canary flag on). @sam can you keep an eye on canary for a couple hours after merge?

sam: happy to watch. i'll run quick smoke prompts and keep an eye on latency and error rate dashboards. ping me if you want a rollback prepared.

marta: thanks everyone — addressed comments, CI passing, PTAL -> merging after canary. :rocket:
